FIFA World Cup 2026 Matches Conclude, Teams Advance

Several matches in the FIFA World Cup 2026 have concluded, with Belgium defeating the U.S. 4-1 to advance to the quarterfinals, eliminating one of the co-hosts. France also secured a spot in the quarterfinals by beating Paraguay. Separately, Belgium's coach noted a serious injury to player Amadou Onana. The tournament also saw discussions around player eligibility and environmental impact.
